totality_policy: Every demonstrated top-level field, source envelope token, record type and transformation-relevant state has an explicit rule/disposition. Any demonstrated shape absent from this matrix fails BINDING_HOLD/UNMAPPED_REPLACEMENT_E1_STRUCTURE; no implicit default. PilotCandidate field presence/value/order is also total under pilot_candidate_totality; no decoder-owned optional field/default is discretionary.

common_fields.escalation_required: always false for replacement-E1 v0.4; no dedicated independent escalation record shape
common_fields.unresolved_effect: true only unresolved-intent root; otherwise false
common_fields.material_conflict: true only exact attached/conflict-only §9 conflict; otherwise false
common_fields.informational_only: exact obligation source boolean on obligation root; otherwise false
common_fields.applicability: always supplied; root-specific exact rule; conflict-only exact conflict-source applicability or UNKNOWN/HOLD
common_fields.freshness: always supplied; exact used evidence reduction UNKNOWN > STALE > CURRENT
common_fields.source_identity: always supplied; exact used evidence reduction CONFLICT > UNKNOWN > VERIFIED
common_fields.provenance_refs: always sorted unique exact typed source_refs actually used
common_fields.possible_duplicate_refs: always array; exact typed other-ref(s) only for unresolved duplicate; otherwise []

pilot_candidate_totality.optional_fields: omitted when not semantically applicable; null substitution prohibited except explicit UNKNOWN values represented by string fields
